headline: Protein language models are augmented with dynamics, structure and reaction context for functional prediction
label: Physics Conditioned Protein Language Models
summary: New preprints and papers attach dynamics, 3D and reactant context to protein language models for variant, PTM, kinetic and turnover prediction.
synthesis: The common thread is conditioning pretrained protein language model representations on biophysical or chemical context rather than relying on sequence alone. DynamicsPLM adds residue-level and pairwise molecular dynamics heads to a 35M-parameter model for zero-shot mutation effects. HieraPTM combines sequence, PLM and 3D structure features to move from PTM site recognition to functional phosphosite prediction. EnzRef adapts frozen PLMs with reference-centered cross-attention and role-aware recomposition of reactant and product conditions for turnover prediction. MGCA pairs ESM2 with Morgan fingerprints in a multi-granularity cross-attention mixture-of-experts for dissociation kinetics. ReMoD-Mol applies a related multimodal fusion and distillation strategy to small-molecule properties. What is new is the move from static structure toward dynamics, mechanics and kinetic endpoints, often with frozen or small backbones.
